expectations.source_clause: - [ ] For each check, report exact argv, exit status, elapsed time, bounded stdout/stderr references, and frozen candidate/source identity.
expectations.claim: Check selected argv, exit code, elapsed, bounded output refs and frozen identities survive an actual run and status readback.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Accept equivalent indexed receipt layout with exact values and identities.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Distinguish observed check failures, missing/insufficient evidence, environment/boundary unavailability, timeouts, and stale receipts.
expectations.claim: Actual failure, absent evidence, unavailable sandbox, timeout and stale receipt are distinct; none fabricated as candidate defects.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Allow different UI wording if machine classification and evidence remain unambiguous.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Successful commands produce a short result and do not trigger another reviewer or unnecessary model invocation.
expectations.claim: Successful check stays concise with no new model calls or reviewer demand.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Additional optional details are fine when default summary remains brief.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Tests cover failing and passing commands, truncated or missing output, timeouts, unauthorized mutation attempts, malformed expected/actual metadata, and correct status re-read.
expectations.claim: Reject malformed expected/actual input, unauthorized mutations and stale readback; do not report passing evidence.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Do not impose undocumented exception class; accept explicit unavailable or integrity-error status.

Independently authored different source-correct implementation; reject reference-specific syntax/layout tests.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] A direct check needs **no** acceptance plan, Intentline/P2P installation, second model call, additional mandatory file or approval ceremony. Existing run/check/status semantics and native sandbox/receipt integrity remain intact.
expectations.claim: Unmapped check/status continues without extra planning artifacts, peer/model calls or changed native receipts.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Any internal representation acceptable if caller-facing behavior is unchanged.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Optional rows identify source-linked obligations and outcomes, including positive and negative behaviors, compatibility constraints and exceptions. Validate IDs, source identity/quoted lines, exact selected-command references and candidate binding; reject missing/stale/contradictory claims. Source text always outranks an incomplete mapping.
expectations.claim: Reject duplicate/incorrect R IDs, forged quotes, stale source or argv/candidate links, without upgrading a plan to authority.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Error response text not prescribed; rejection and identity binding are.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Report, **per supplied obligation**, actual linked-check outcomes: `LINKED CHECKS PASSED (limited evidence)`, `CHECK FAILED`, `CHECK UNAVAILABLE`, or `NOT DEMONSTRATED`. Never call a green command proof of the full obligation or all obligations. A requirement with *no selected check* is not demonstrated, not failed.
expectations.claim: An unlinked source obligation is NOT DEMONSTRATED even with all other selected checks green; pass remains bounded.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Alternative JSON field organization is fine if per-R distinctions remain.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Support an **optional step by the same existing coding agent**: reread the complete original source, compare it with the recorded rows/selected checks, and propose any apparent omitted material promise or high-value negative/compatibility case with a verbatim source citation and test suggestion. Record such findings as **proposals/gaps**, not authenticated or complete review. Proofline itself dispatches zero extra models. If no gap analysis was performed, make coverage completeness **unknown**, not silently complete.
expectations.claim: No implicit completeness assertion where no gap analysis was performed; original request remains primary.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Coverage metadata may be absent or explicitly unknown but never complete.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] The existing `proofline.py check` still works unchanged with only the original request and selected check argv. No Intentline install, account, extra config, planning skill, model invocation or second approval is required.
expectations.claim: Without Intentline opt-in, source + check argv still work without extra model/service, account, approval, or config.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Implementation can wrap the optional adapter differently without changing default CLI.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] On explicit opt-in only, read supported Intentline export **as untrusted data**. Validate the completion marker, every imported byte hash, contract/source revision identity and original request's exact bytes against the Proofline request. Reject mismatch, stale/partial/missing data, ambiguous source/adoption claims and unsupported successor formats; no executable exported scripts.
expectations.claim: Unsupported/tampered export source, manifest bytes, revision or adoption metadata rejected before trust or execution.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Both schema validation orders acceptable if neither accepts corrupted package.

expectations.source_clause: Implement one **read-only, explicitly opted-in adapter** that converts a supported Intentline export into the generic promise/evidence input defined by [#13](https://github.com/grove/proofline/issues/13). Start with **a single original-request acceptance schema 1 export** (e.g. `export --format json` with its complete `export-manifest.json`, `contract.json`, source manifest and original source capture). If amended/lineage/native bundles cannot be validated fully, **reject with an exact unsupported-format explanation**; never flatten them to a misleading single request. Future expansion needs evidence of value.
expectations.claim: Unsupported lineage/amendment/native bundle must be rejected clearly; no flattening to first revision.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent explicit unsupported error without reference implementation wording.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Link only explicitly selected executable check receipts to the *exact frozen candidate* and imported requirement IDs. Unlinked obligations are reported **NOT DEMONSTRATED**; green commands don't establish that the requirements inventory is exhaustive.
expectations.claim: Only exact selected executable checks bound to exact frozen candidate and R IDs; unlinked obligations not demonstrated.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Any internal join design acceptable when identity checks and status semantics remain.

expectations.source_clause: 1. Enhance the existing `promise_evidence.format_lines()` / optional evidence report to surface **bounded, per-R next-check hints** for NOT DEMONSTRATED requirements. Derive hints **only from fields already validated and retained** by the direct promise mapping (if present) and optional Intentline import (`planned_evidence`, `boundaries`, `seam`, `evidence_gap_reasons`, source citations). Do **not** infer tests from arbitrary source prose or invent executable commands.
expectations.claim: Source-linked unlinked R gets bounded actionable next-check advice; normal no-mapping path stays concise.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent output formatting acceptable if link/gap/advice present.

expectations.source_clause: 2. Distinguish: **no linked check**, **failed linked check**, **unavailable/stale evidence**, and **caller/Intentline-proposed check**. Recommend an additional selected check for an *unlinked* requirement, diagnosing actual failure evidence for a *failed* check, or restoring re-runnable evidence for *unavailable/stale* checks. Never describe absent evidence as an implementation defect.
expectations.claim: Separate unlinked gap from failed linked check, stale evidence and unavailable sandbox; advise relevant next action without asserting defect.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Other wording okay if actual reason and next step remain correct.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] Hints never assert that a passed check semantically proves a requirement, or that all source requirements have been captured. All completion/coverage claims remain UNKNOWN beyond bounded receipts.
expectations.claim: Neither green checks nor proposed tests certify semantic completeness; overall coverage still UNKNOWN.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: May omit global message on unlinked-free default only if status still truthful.

expectations.source_clause: - [ ] No fabricated check argv, claims of tests executed, inherited approval, source rewriting, automatic link guessing, or execution of exported planning artifacts. Missing fields are handled without invented expectations.
expectations.claim: Never construct imaginary executable argv or pretend to have executed/check linked it based on advisory source text.
expectations.probe_plan: Independent executable or inspected-source probe to be specified and reviewed; not yet implemented
acceptable_alternatives: Explicitly ask agent to choose or author executable check without implying its success.
